title: FermatQuinticHost: Init-Only Lean 4.22 Host Certificate for the Fermat Quintic Fourfold V(F_5) in P^5
description: Standalone Init-only Lean 4.22 formalization (`Hodge/VF5.lean`) defining the host arithmetic and degree/weight invariants of the smooth Fermat quintic fourfold V(F_5) subset P^5 with zero external Mathlib dependencies. Explicitly certified as a host definition and arithmetic invariant module (`Hodge/VF5.lean`) with Z uncomputed; not a proof or disproof of the Clay Hodge Conjecture.
